title: A hand-cranked generator
body: A school science club builds a hand-cranked ac generator. Its armature is a rectangular coil of 200 turns, each of area 0.05 m^2, mounted on a shaft whose axis is perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of 0.02 T. A student turns the handle so that the coil makes 2 revolutions every second at a steady rate. At t = 0 the plane of the coil is perpendicular to the field, so the angle between the field and the area vector of the coil is zero. The ends of the coil are connected through slip rings and brushes to a small bulb and a voltmeter. The club observes that the reading keeps changing in size and sign as the coil turns.
